description: This file defines the ServiceConfig class, which models the <service-config> XML element in the project. It includes methods for creating an instance from XML, and provides access to contained ServiceEngine objects.

classes.name: ServiceConfig
classes.description: Models the <service-config> XML element, encapsulating a collection of ServiceEngine instances.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a ServiceConfig instance from an XML Element, parsing child elements named 'service-engine' and constructing ServiceEngine objects.

methods.name: getServiceEngines
methods.description: Returns a collection of all ServiceEngine objects contained within the service configuration.

methods.name: getServiceEngine
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ServiceEngine by name from the configuration.
